name: Animate Weapon Necromancer
summary: Animate Weapon turns the weapons a map drops into a temporary melee army. Each cast adds another animated blade, so the build snowballs through a map and then carries the same swarm into the boss room. It needs no unique, only weapons on the ground and a Necromancer shell to keep them alive.

pros.text: Every weapon drop becomes another soldier, which is unlike any other minion build.
Damage scales with minion notables and gem levels, not with your own gear.
The swarm takes the hits, so your positioning is forgiving.
No required unique; the build works from the first dropped weapon.
A strong single-target army once the blades are stacked.
The same caster gear serves any later Necromancer build.

cons.text: The army needs weapons on the ground, so the first pack of a map is the slowest.
Animated weapons expire, and a boss phase can outlast them.
Minion AI spreads the swarm and can leave a straggler behind.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a well-geared melee mapper.
Fewer links early means the blade count matters more than the tooltip.

summary.text: Animate Weapon Necromancer turns dropped weapons into a temporary melee army that snowballs through a map. It measures 30.8k at red maps and 47.4k at pinnacle, and needs no unique.

leveling.text: Level with Summon Skeletons until the first weapons drop, then animate every blade you find. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 131 damage; the second measures 507.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 30.8k damage, 27508 effective life and 12058 physical max hit. Animate the first pack's weapons, then keep the swarm moving with Flesh Offering.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 47.4k damage with 32000 effective life and 11448 physical max hit. Stack the blades before the burst, refresh Flesh Offering, and recast Animate Weapon when the oldest blades expire.
